review_candidates.title: IT Support Specialist - Remote Opportunity
review_candidates.description: About the Company Harris is one of the country's leading mechanical contractors, serving customers across industries and regional locations throughout the United States. The company delivers projects of varying sizes and complexity, including work in stadiums, manufacturing facilities, power plants, hospitals, concert halls, and classrooms. Harris combines the resources of a national organization with the team culture and customer focus of a local business. About the Role Harris is seeking an IT Support Specialist to provide technical assistance to employees across the organization. This role involves troubleshooting computer systems, software, and peripheral equipment, managing service requests, and resolving technical issues through remote support tools, telephone, email, and in-person assistance. You will assess support requests, determine appropriate resolutions or escalations, document each issue from initial contact through closure, and follow up in accordance with established service-level standards. The position also supports IT equipment deployment, software installation, system documentation, inventory management, and ticketing workflow improvements. Key Responsibilities Receive, respond to, and monitor technical support requests, updating ticket records to document activities and request status. Follow established escalation procedures when advanced troubleshooting or application support is required. Answer technical questions, provide end-user training, and resolve issues by telephone, email, and remote support tools. Provision access to software applications and folders using approved administrative tools and solutions. Support users throughout the equipment and account lifecycle, including initial setup, account creation, onboarding, file access, equipment replacement, data transfers, account termination, and equipment return. Create and maintain internal and external IT documentation covering technical procedures, troubleshooting steps, and workflows. Administer the primary ticketing system by creating and updating ticket templates, automations, and triggers to improve efficiency and coordinate workflows. Participate in the Project Management Office (PMO) governance process to understand the organization's technology strategy. Meet assigned project deadlines, milestones, and deliverable requirements. Identify, collect, and analyze data related to application and software issues to support incident reporting and resolution. Assist with the deployment and relocation of computers and peripheral equipment. Maintain required key performance indicators (KPIs) for technical support, ticket quality, and service-level agreements (SLAs). Create and maintain application and end-user documentation in accordance with departmental, company, and industry standards. Investigate, track, troubleshoot, and resolve minor project, system, and application errors within expected timelines. Maintain an inventory of loaned laptops, desktops, peripheral equipment, and accessories, and request replacements as needed. Develop and apply standard computer images with authorized software to ensure consistent configurations. Assist in preparing integrated testing scenarios for application deployment and configuration. Research information systems across multiple organizational levels and states, including their relationships and dependencies. Stay informed about current business practices and technology innovation. Investigate the root causes of underperforming processes and recommend corrective actions, including opportunities for automation. Required Qualifications High school diploma. Help desk or technical support experience. At least 2 years of experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues in a business environment. Strong customer service skills and a professional approach to user support. Proficiency with office productivity software. Ability to use hardware and software diagnostic tools in a Microsoft Windows environment. Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and organizational skills. Ability to manage service requests, prioritize tasks, and follow established support procedures. Salary and Benefits The hourly pay range is $23.07–$34.60. The actual offer will depend on factors including relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance. 401(k) retirement plan with company matching. Vacation time, sick time, and paid holidays. Paid parental leave. Sales Incentive Plan. Location and Work Arrangement The position provides company-wide technical support through remote and in-person assistance. Specific location and work arrangement details were not provided. Equal Employment Opportunity Harris is an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcomes protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. The employer provides applicants with information about their rights under federal employment laws, including the Department of Labor's Know Your Rights notice.
